hypothesis: Bounded syntax-only source revision signals can identify changed written declarations while withholding a documentation decision, and distinguish a helper-only module change from unchanged selected declaration text.
source_family_exposure: Cachetools revisions already manually inspected; all followup cases are development-exposed, not independent holdout.
proposed_api: Memory-only explicit source cards, up to8selectors,3secondworker,64KiB/source,8192ASTnodes/source,24KiBcombinedquotes; no filesystem source search or source execution.
output_boundary: Structural module/declaration differences and unknowns only; never ADD/MODIFY/REMOVE/NO-OP publication recommendations. Identical selected AST with changed enclosing module still requires dependency review.
